messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Private repos on stan-dev are being moved to gelman
parts:
But... there aren't enough private repos left on gelman.

Could any of these repos be moved to other accounts or removed?
- nih-andreaae-2015 -- Michael A., want to make this your user's repo?
- blackboard -- Michael or Alp, want to move this to your repo? Or make it public?
- fast-autodiff and fast_autodiff -- Michael, could we consolidate the two repos? Or if they're not useful now, we can remove them.
- hier_reparam -- Michael, is this useful any more? Can I put this under the private "papers" repo?

The rest look straightforward to move.


Daniel

There are some dead repos in the gelman organization and not all the ones that are moving are used


Daniel
